nodes.description: address public owner; stores the privileged owner address checked in access-control require statements
constructor() public; initializes owner with msg.sender
transferFrom(IERC20Token,address,address) external; owner-only, pulls full allowance from _sender to _receiver via token external call
transferLinkLessGas(IERC20Token,address,address,uint256) external; owner-only, forwards caller-supplied amount via token external call
msg.sender read in the constructor and written into the owner state variable
msg.sender compared against owner in transferFrom's access-control require
msg.sender compared against owner in transferLinkLessGas's access-control require
external call _token.transferFrom(_sender,_receiver,amount) executed inside transferFrom on an attacker-suppliable token address
external call _token.transferFrom(_sender,_receiver,_amount) executed inside transferLinkLessGas on an attacker-suppliable token address
IERC20Token _token parameter of transferFrom; supplies the arbitrary external call target
address _sender parameter of transferFrom; source account of the token transfer and allowance query
address _receiver parameter of transferFrom; destination account of the token transfer
IERC20Token _token parameter of transferLinkLessGas; supplies the arbitrary external call target
address _sender parameter of transferLinkLessGas; source account of the token transfer
address _receiver parameter of transferLinkLessGas; destination account of the token transfer
uint256 _amount parameter of transferLinkLessGas; caller-supplied transfer value
uint256 amount local variable in transferFrom; result of _token.allowance(_sender,address(this))

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to establish the deployer as privileged account
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable, setting the access-control principal
msg.sender value flows directly into the owner state variable during deployment
transferFrom's require compares untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner value
msg.sender == owner check gates entry into transferFrom
Stored owner value used as the authorization predicate for transferFrom
transferLinkLessGas's require compares untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner value
msg.sender == owner check gates entry into transferLinkLessGas
Stored owner value used as the authorization predicate for transferLinkLessGas
_token is the contract on which allowance(_sender, address(this)) is queried for the amount local
_sender is the owner argument of the allowance query producing amount
Derived allowance amount is forwarded as the value of the external token transfer call
_token determines the address of the external transferFrom call
_sender is forwarded as the from argument of the external token call
_receiver is forwarded as the to argument of the external token call
transferFrom body executes the external token call before returning
_token determines the address of the external transferFrom call in transferLinkLessGas
_sender is forwarded as the from argument of the external token call
_receiver is forwarded as the to argument of the external token call
_amount is forwarded directly as the value of the external token call
transferLinkLessGas body executes the external token call before returning
External call to a caller-controlled token may re-enter transferFrom before it returns
External call to a caller-controlled token may re-enter transferLinkLessGas before it returns

_sender is passed straight into the unsafe external transferFrom call as the from argument
_receiver is passed straight into the unsafe external transferFrom call as the to argument
amount is computed only to be consumed as the value argument of the unsafe external call
